# TIC 323434013: CONFIRMED attributed eclipsing system

Gaia is SB2, not SB1: own bit255/21correlation ordering was verified against ESA documentation. Sixty-five fits of each kind, equal depths, alternate reduction and tight target deficit establish the EB at full3.071615d. SB2 amplitudes independently yield q0.9046, M1sin3i1.19244solar, M2sin3i1.07870solar and a sini11.6887Rsun. Fixed-TIC geometry fits poorly (chi2~1314/121); precise component radii and e sin omega are not inferred.

Physical verdict: **CONFIRMED**. Full review: **complete**. Novelty: no target EB match in the current specified archives; limited prior-art coverage, not a claim of discovery priority. Physical EB identification is distinct from component characterization.

Blind raw-SAP rolling-median census contains171 runs;0 off-primary/off-secondary runs deeper than half median primary after duration allowances. This census is a diagnostic, not proof that every small run is stellar. Sector-wide dip list and quality/background gates are addressed by repeated events, independent reduction and localization; known systematic times alone cannot explain these orbital event sequences.
Backgrounds were regressed in their native units and projected through the same template into fake normalized depth; raw SAP_BKG values are never divided by normalized SAP flux. Maximum absolute fake primary depth=0.663ppt; event-level BG refits, flags, centroids and scan-edge status remain in JSON. Shape/baseline limitations above bound precision; they do not erase the repeated source-localized eclipses.

**CONFIRMED** target eclipsing system: Gaia is SB2, not SB1: own bit255/21correlation ordering was verified against ESA documentation. Sixty-five fits of each kind, equal depths, alternate reduction and tight target deficit establish the EB at full3.071615d. SB2 amplitudes independently yield q0.9046, M1sin3i1.19244solar, M2sin3i1.07870solar and a sini11.6887Rsun. Fixed-TIC geometry fits poorly (chi2~1314/121); precise component radii and e sin omega are not inferred.
